name: Speko
long_description: Speko is a voice agent platform for business phone calls: teams build, test, run and monitor AI phone agents for scripted calls such as interviews, candidate screens and intake. Use cases include hiring screens, clinic intake, customer support and appointment booking. Simulated callers test each draft, and an AI judge reviews each call. Free credit on signup, no sales call needed. Speko is audited for SOC 2 Type 2 and compliant with HIPAA and GDPR. Speko is based in San Francisco (YC S26).
one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Business Calls
